entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was an unusual day for the resid..."
entries.dialogueText: It was an unusual day for the residents of Holsord. Regularly used streets and avenues were blocked off by the military personnel. Many shops and cafes were closed and once crowded stores were now empty. Instead, thousands of residents in Holsord were concentrated in one street, Victory Avenue.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Stretching out through the heart of..."
entries.dialogueText: Stretching out through the heart of Holsord, people on both sides of the road were waving their Sordish flags proudly for the military parade.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was getting prepared to embark on..."
entries.dialogueText: I was getting prepared to embark on my trip. It was going to be a short drive down the Victory Avenue until we reached Maroon Palace. My company for this trip was Iosef with Serge, as usual, driving the presidential car.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's get this over with.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's get this over with.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I nodded."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Mr. President. We are almost ready..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. We are almost ready.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef approached me. He was wearing..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef approached me. He was wearing his decorated ceremony outfit. He carried a sword with a goat head at the handle and his pistol by his hip. He put on his cap.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge appeared from the entrance an..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge appeared from the entrance and joined us.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“We will depart right after the tan..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will depart right after the tank column.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After hearing the loud thump of a b..."
entries.dialogueText: After hearing the loud thump of a book falling down to the floor, he turned to a couple of privates that were doing the preparations on the schedule and started walking in their direction.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Rumburg will think twice after tod..."
entries.dialogueText: “Rumburg will think twice after today.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“They will tremble before the Sordi..."
entries.dialogueText: “They will tremble before the Sordish military might.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef nodded.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Private! Can't you do your job pro..."
entries.dialogueText: “Private! Can't you do your job properly?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I watched the young soldiers perfor..."
entries.dialogueText: I watched the young soldiers perform a lousy salute to Iosef.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“WHAT IS THAT SALUTE SOLDIER? WATCH..."
entries.dialogueText: “WHAT IS THAT SALUTE SOLDIER? WATCH! THIS IS A REAL SALUTE!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He performed an excellent salute an..."
entries.dialogueText: He performed an excellent salute and after scolding the privates he walked back.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Old habits die hard.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Old habits die hard.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Strict as ever.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Strict as ever.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Doesn't give me much confidence th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Doesn't give me much confidence that our soldiers do not even know how to properly salute.”
entries.menuText: “Doesn't give me much confidence that our soldiers do not even know how to properly salute.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Is it time yet?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Is it time yet?”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I will have him educated.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I will have him educated.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Very soon.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very soon.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Mr. Lancea.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Lancea.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge performed a salute to Iosef w..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge performed a salute to Iosef which made Iosef smile under his moustache.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“At ease, Mr. Wolkner.”"
entries.dialogueText: “At ease, Mr. Wolkner.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Are we ready to depart yet?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Are we ready to depart yet?”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Yes, sir. Follow me please.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, sir. Follow me please.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We started following Serge through..."
entries.dialogueText: We started following Serge through the corridors.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Mr. President. Have you seen the t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. Have you seen the tanks? Our planes too?”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Rumburg will be so scared when the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Rumburg will be so scared when they see this.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes, Serge. I have seen it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, Serge. I have seen it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That is the plan.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That is the plan.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I sure hope so.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I sure hope so.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“A great one, I'd say.”"
entries.dialogueText: “A great one, I'd say.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“My kids were very excited to wake..."
entries.dialogueText: “My kids were very excited to wake up today. You know. To see the planes fly.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I am sure, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am sure, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Serge, where did you do your milit..."
entries.dialogueText: “Serge, where did you do your military service?”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Morna. 7th Artillery Squadron. I s..."
entries.dialogueText: “Morna. 7th Artillery Squadron. I still talk with many of my friends from those days.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“The camaraderie of military is nev..."
entries.dialogueText: “The camaraderie of military is never forgotten. I'm still in touch with my friends from basic training as well."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“What about you, sir? Where did you..."
entries.dialogueText: “What about you, sir? Where did you serve?”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“All over Sordland. You know, Mr. P..."
entries.dialogueText: “All over Sordland. You know, Mr. President was under my command once. Gumren Outpost.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I do. Rough times.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I do. Rough times.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Who can forget about Major Lancea?..."
entries.dialogueText: “Who can forget about Major Lancea? We called him 'The Relentless'.”
entries.menuText: “Who can forget about Major Lancea? We called him 'The Relentless'.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Indeed. Those were rough times.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Indeed. Those were rough times.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Good old days.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good old days.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef let out a long laugh."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef let out a long laugh.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to me."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to me.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Do you remember those days?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Do you remember those days?”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I also remember, Mr. President did..."
entries.dialogueText: “I also remember, Mr. President did not like to execute direct orders from his superiors.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I did what needed to be done.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I did what needed to be done.”
entries.menuText: “I did what needed to be done.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's in the past now.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's in the past now.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's cut the chit chat and do wha..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's cut the chit chat and do what we are here to do.”
entries.menuText: “Let's cut the chit chat and do what we are here to do.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Which was disobeying orders. But I..."
entries.dialogueText: “Which was disobeying orders. But I won't delve into the past.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“True.”"
entries.dialogueText: “True.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Very well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“We are here, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We are here, sir.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We exited the building and walked o..."
entries.dialogueText: We exited the building and walked over to the clearance where the black Kadila, the presidential car, was waiting. It was decorated properly for the event and the top canopy had been removed so that we could stand and wave to people.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We entered the car and Serge starte..."
entries.dialogueText: We entered the car and Serge started the engine. Iosef was standing right next to me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A group of ten, maybe twelve latest..."
entries.dialogueText: A group of ten, maybe twelve latest technology S-16 fighter jets flew above our heads and I thought that the engine sounds was going to leave me deaf. Loud footsteps of the marching soldiers were followed by loud noises coming from tank engines.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We waited for a few minutes for the..."
entries.dialogueText: We waited for a few minutes for the announcement. Finally, it was our turn. On both sides of the Victory Avenue there were numerous citizens cheering my name, waving their Sordish flags.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I waved to the people."
entries.dialogueText: I waved to the people.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I saluted."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I raised my fist."
entries.dialogueText: I raised my fist.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We kept our slow and steady pace. W..."
entries.dialogueText: We kept our slow and steady pace. We were almost at the Artor S. Wisci statue several hundred meters away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The convoy continued. As I looked a..."
entries.dialogueText: The convoy continued. As I looked around and saw that there was a military truck parked next to the statue in the distance.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Hey Iosef, is that truck part of t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Hey Iosef, is that truck part of the parade?”
entries.menuText: “Hey Iosef, is that truck part of the parade?”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I shrugged it off. It was probably..."
entries.dialogueText: I shrugged it off. It was probably nothing.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Yes it is, sir. Although I am not..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes it is, sir. Although I am not sure why it is not following the motorcade.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I will make sure they are punished..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will make sure they are punished.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We continued and neared the statue."
entries.dialogueText: We continued and neared the statue.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The truck was standing in the middl..."
entries.dialogueText: The truck was standing in the middle of the road blocking the parade a few dozen meters in-front of us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His jaw was clenched and his hand w..."
entries.dialogueText: His jaw was clenched and his hand was slowly making its way to the gun on his hip.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Was this scheduled?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Was this scheduled?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What is going on? Do you see the t..."
entries.dialogueText: “What is going on? Do you see the truck?”
entries.menuText: “What is going on? Do you see the truck?”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“No.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Something is not right.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Something is not right.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“What on earth is going on with tha..."
entries.dialogueText: “What on earth is going on with that truck? Bring the guards at once. Do you copy?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His other hand went to his radio."
entries.dialogueText: His other hand went to his radio.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I radioed the instru-”"
entries.dialogueText: “I radioed the instru-”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Three men who jumped out of the tru..."
entries.dialogueText: Three men who jumped out of the truck started running towards our car. They were holding KA-74's pointed right at us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In a split second Iosef pulled his..."
entries.dialogueText: In a split second Iosef pulled his pistol and shot at the gunmen.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "<shout>“SERGE! FLOOR IT! NOW!”</sho..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“SERGE! FLOOR IT! NOW!”</shout>

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "<shout>“REVERSE! GET DOWN! THEY ARE..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“REVERSE! GET DOWN! THEY ARE GONNA SHOOT!”</shout>
entries.menuText: “REVERSE! GET DOWN! THEY ARE GONNA SHOOT!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge quickly accelerated the car...."
entries.dialogueText: Serge quickly accelerated the car. The gunmen started firing and my ears started ringing. The sounds of the bullet impacts were horrifying.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge reversed the car at full spee..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge reversed the car at full speed and ducked.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "<shout>“MR. PRESIDENT. ARE YOU OKAY..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“MR. PRESIDENT. ARE YOU OKAY?”</shout>

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "<shout>“ANSWER ME.”</shout>"
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“ANSWER ME.”</shout>

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm okay.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'm okay.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What just happened!?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What just happened!?”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Thank God! He is alive!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank God! He is alive!”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Are you injured? Do you feel any p..."
entries.dialogueText: “Are you injured? Do you feel any pain?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I checked my body and didn't feel a..."
entries.dialogueText: I checked my body and didn't feel any injuries. I shook my head. I saw the wound on Iosef's right shoulder.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was bleeding."
entries.dialogueText: He was bleeding.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Nevermind me. Are you alright?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Nevermind me. Are you alright?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are we safe?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Are we safe?”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“It's just a bullet in the shoulder..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's just a bullet in the shoulder, sir. Nothing critical.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“We are for now.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We are for now.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The car horn wouldn't stop blaring...."
entries.dialogueText: The car horn wouldn't stop blaring. I looked over to the driver's seat.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Mr. President. I'm sorr-”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. I'm sorr-”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge's head was leaning against th..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge's head was leaning against the wheel, completely motionless.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I froze."
entries.dialogueText: I froze.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What happened to the attackers?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What happened to the attackers?”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“They are dead. I got one of them t..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are dead. I got one of them the guards handled the other two.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“THEY WILL PAY FOR THIS.”"
entries.dialogueText: “THEY WILL PAY FOR THIS.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No. This can't be true.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No. This can't be true.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“They will, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “They will, sir.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I'm afraid it is.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'm afraid it is.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Emergency medical teams arrived and..."
entries.dialogueText: Emergency medical teams arrived and started examining me. After confirming that we had no injuries, I stood up and took a look around.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They started taking care of Iosef a..."
entries.dialogueText: They started taking care of Iosef and put him on a stretcher. He was yelling.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "<shout>“HOW CAN YOU LET THIS HAPPEN..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“HOW CAN YOU LET THIS HAPPEN? IDIOTS, ALL OF YOU!”</shout>

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“YOU CAN'T EVEN PROTECT YOUR OWN PR..."
entries.dialogueText: “YOU CAN'T EVEN PROTECT YOUR OWN PRESIDENT! WHY WAS I THE FIRST ONE TO RESPOND?!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef was put in an ambulance and t..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef was put in an ambulance and taken away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I watched the medics pull out Serge..."
entries.dialogueText: I watched the medics pull out Serge's lifeless body from the car and place it into a black body bag.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Trails of blood were leading to the..."
entries.dialogueText: Trails of blood were leading to the dead gunmen behind the presidential car.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They started firing and my ears sta..."
entries.dialogueText: They started firing and my ears started ringing. I could hear the bullets impacting the car as we reversed and hit a roadblock behind us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I dared to look up for a second and..."
entries.dialogueText: I dared to look up for a second and saw that Iosef had his pistol drawn, shooting back at the attackers. I checked my body and didn't feel any injuries.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw the wound on Iosef's right sh..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw the wound on Iosef's right shoulder. He was shot.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "<shout>“I SAID GET DOWN!”</shout>"
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“I SAID GET DOWN!”</shout>

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I tried to pull him back to the cov..."
entries.dialogueText: I tried to pull him back to the cover but he didn't flinch.
entries.menuText: Pull him back to the cover.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As he stumbled, he pointed his pist..."
entries.dialogueText: As he stumbled, he pointed his pistol, aimed and then fired at the gunmen.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A brief gunfight ensued outside as..."
entries.dialogueText: A brief gunfight ensued outside as the police and soldiers rushed over to secure the vehicle. There was a complete silence and the screams from of the crowd subdued.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are they dead? Is it over?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Are they dead? Is it over?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Iosef, are you okay?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Iosef, are you okay?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a muffled sound from the..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a muffled sound from the front seat.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Is everyone alright!?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Is everyone alright!?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef turned to me after grunting."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef turned to me after grunting.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef turned to me after grunting."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef turned to me after grunting.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I've been better, sir. Got two of..."
entries.dialogueText: “I've been better, sir. Got two of them.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I got two of them.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I got two of them.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“What just happene-”"
entries.dialogueText: “What just happene-”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "<shout>“SIR! ARE YOU ALRIGHT?”</sho..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“SIR! ARE YOU ALRIGHT?”</shout>

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm fine. Are you injured?”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'm fine. Are you injured?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No, Serge. I won't be fine until t..."
entries.dialogueText: “No, Serge. I won't be fine until they pay for what they have done.”
entries.menuText: “No, Serge. I won't be fine until they pay for what they have done.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“No injuries, sir. Thank God.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No injuries, sir. Thank God.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He patted himself down."
entries.dialogueText: He patted himself down.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“They will pay, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “They will pay, sir.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Mr. Lancea is a tough cookie to cr..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Lancea is a tough cookie to crack.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I'm not dead yet.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'm not dead yet.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He grunted in pain again."
entries.dialogueText: He grunted in pain again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Emergency medical teams arrived and..."
entries.dialogueText: Emergency medical teams arrived and started examining me. After confirming that we had no injuries, I stood up and took a look around.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They started taking care of Iosef a..."
entries.dialogueText: They started taking care of Iosef and put him on a stretcher. He was yelling.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "<shout>“HOW CAN YOU LET THIS HAPPEN..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“HOW CAN YOU LET THIS HAPPEN? IDIOTS, ALL OF YOU!”</shout>

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef was put in an ambulance and t..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef was put in an ambulance and taken away.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“YOU CAN'T EVEN PROTECT YOUR OWN PR..."
entries.dialogueText: “YOU CAN'T EVEN PROTECT YOUR OWN PRESIDENT! WHY WAS I THE FIRST ONE TO RESPOND?!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Trails of blood were leading to the..."
entries.dialogueText: Trails of blood were leading to the dead gunmen behind the presidential car.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was finally placed in an ambulanc..."
entries.dialogueText: I was finally placed in an ambulance as well and was rushed to the hospital.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A couple of old propeller planes fl..."
entries.dialogueText: A couple of old propeller planes flew above our heads and I thought whether the planes were older than me. Loud footsteps of the marching soldiers were followed by loud noises coming from tank engines.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The tanks came into my view. They w..."
entries.dialogueText: The tanks came into my view. They were top of the line modern battle tanks. Their shining armour under the sun invigorated national pride.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The tanks came into my view. They w..."
entries.dialogueText: The tanks came into my view. They were not the most modern models however they displayed our military might. I couldn't even finish my thought and one of the tanks broke down and had to be towed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the way to the car, generals and..."
entries.dialogueText: On the way to the car, generals and admirals were lined up on both sides of the carpet. The atmosphere immediately changed when these experienced men who fought many times for their country saluted me. I saluted back with respect.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the way to the car, generals and..."
entries.dialogueText: On the way to the car, generals and admirals were lined up on both sides of the carpet. I was surprised by the young age of some generals. I wondered whether they have even seen any action.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A group of soldiers saluted me as w..."
entries.dialogueText: A group of soldiers saluted me as we passed by. They did not even have matching guns. Iosef turned to me.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“This is all result of the cuts, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is all result of the cuts, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A group of soldiers saluted me as w..."
entries.dialogueText: A group of soldiers saluted me as we passed by. They looked proud and stout in the new infantry uniforms and with brand-new rifles.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We continued on as per the schedule..."
entries.dialogueText: We continued on as per the schedule and finally arrived at the Maroon Palace which marked the end of the parade.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "People of Holsord dispersed to thei..."
entries.dialogueText: People of Holsord dispersed to their homes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A clear message was sent to Rumburg..."
entries.dialogueText: A clear message was sent to Rumburg by the display of our military might.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We were about to see whether it wou..."
entries.dialogueText: We were about to see whether it would be enough or not.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We exited the building and walked o..."
entries.dialogueText: We exited the building and walked over to the clearance where the black Kadila, the presidential car, was waiting. It was decorated properly for the event and the top canopy had been removed so that I could stand and wave to people.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I entered the car and Serge started..."
entries.dialogueText: I entered the car and Serge started the engine. Iosef saluted me. We were on our way shortly.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Good luck, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good luck, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The car started rolling."
entries.dialogueText: The car started rolling.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The car started rolling."
entries.dialogueText: The car started rolling.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Even though there were many walls a..."
entries.dialogueText: Even though there were many walls and trees in between the car and the crowd, I was able to hear the deafening sounds of cheering Sordish citizens. Gradually we made our way to the starting point.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A group of soldiers saluted me as w..."
entries.dialogueText: A group of soldiers saluted me as we passed by. They did not even have matching guns.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The convoy continued. As I looked a..."
entries.dialogueText: The convoy continued. As I looked around and saw that there was a military truck parked next to the statue in the distance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We continued and neared the statue."
entries.dialogueText: We continued and neared the statue.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Hey Serge, is that truck part of t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Hey Serge, is that truck part of the parade?”
entries.menuText: “Hey Serge, is that truck part of the parade?”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I shrugged it off. It was probably..."
entries.dialogueText: I shrugged it off. It was probably nothing.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I think so, Mr. President. Althoug..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think so, Mr. President. Although I am not sure why it's parked.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The truck was standing in the middl..."
entries.dialogueText: The truck was standing in the middle of the road blocking the parade a few dozen meters in-front of us.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Was this scheduled?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Was this scheduled?”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I- I don't think so, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I- I don't think so, sir.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What is going on? Do you see the t..."
entries.dialogueText: “What is going on? Do you see the truck?”
entries.menuText: “What is going on? Do you see the truck?”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I- I don't know, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I- I don't know, sir.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His jaw was clenched and he was int..."
entries.dialogueText: His jaw was clenched and he was intently watching.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Something's wrong.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Something's wrong.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge then picked up the radio."
entries.dialogueText: Serge then picked up the radio.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“There seems to be a truck on the w..."
entries.dialogueText: “There seems to be a truck on the way. Is this part of the schedu-”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Three men who jumped out of the tru..."
entries.dialogueText: Three men who jumped out of the truck started running towards our car. They were holding KA-74's pointed right at us.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "<shout>“SERGE! FLOOR IT! NOW!”</sho..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“SERGE! FLOOR IT! NOW!”</shout>

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge quickly accelerated the car."
entries.dialogueText: Serge quickly accelerated the car.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gunmen started firing and my ears s..."
entries.dialogueText: Gunmen started firing and my ears started ringing. The sounds of the bullet impacts were horrifying.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a complete silence follow..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a complete silence followed by screams from the crowd.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The car hit one of the soldiers. We..."
entries.dialogueText: The car hit one of the soldiers. We were about to crash into the truck in-front of us.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "<shout>“REVERSE! GET DOWN! THEY ARE..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“REVERSE! GET DOWN! THEY ARE GONNA SHOOT!”</shout>
entries.menuText: “REVERSE! GET DOWN! THEY ARE GONNA SHOOT!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I regained consciousness after the..."
entries.dialogueText: I regained consciousness after the crash. The muffled screams from the crowd combined with the car horn.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I started praying to the God."
entries.dialogueText: I started praying to the God.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge reversed the car at full spee..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge reversed the car at full speed and ducked.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They started firing and my ears sta..."
entries.dialogueText: They started firing and my ears started ringing. I could hear the bullets impacting the car as we reversed and hit a roadblock behind us.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“They will pay, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “They will pay, sir.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm fine. Are you injured?”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'm fine. Are you injured?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a muffled sound from the..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a muffled sound from the front seat.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“What just happene-”"
entries.dialogueText: “What just happene-”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“No injuries, sir. Thank God.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No injuries, sir. Thank God.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "<shout>“SIR! ARE YOU ALRIGHT?”</sho..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“SIR! ARE YOU ALRIGHT?”</shout>

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No, Serge. I won't be fine until t..."
entries.dialogueText: “No, Serge. I won't be fine until they pay for what they have done.”
entries.menuText: “No, Serge. I won't be fine until they pay for what they have done.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pat himself down."
entries.dialogueText: He pat himself down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Emergency medical teams arrived and..."
entries.dialogueText: Emergency medical teams arrived and started examining me and Serge. After confirming that we had no injuries, I stood up and took a look around.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The car was dotted with bullet hole..."
entries.dialogueText: The car was dotted with bullet holes. The bodies of dead gunmen were in-front of it. It was a miracle that no one died.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The car horn just wouldn't stop. I..."
entries.dialogueText: The car horn just wouldn't stop. I looked over to the driver seat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge's head was leaning against th..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge's head was leaning against the wheel, completely motionless.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I froze."
entries.dialogueText: I froze.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Trails of blood were leading to the..."
entries.dialogueText: Trails of blood were leading to the dead gunmen behind the presidential car.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Emergency medical teams arrived and..."
entries.dialogueText: Emergency medical teams arrived and started examining me. After confirming that we had no injuries, I stood up and took a look around.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I watched the medics pull out Serge..."
entries.dialogueText: I watched the medics pull out Serge's lifeless body from the car and into a black body bag.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I held on as tight as I could."
entries.dialogueText: I held on as tight as I could.
entries.menuText: Hold on as tightly as you can.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I closed my eyes."
entries.dialogueText: I closed my eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I closed my eyes."
entries.dialogueText: I closed my eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I started praying to the God."
entries.dialogueText: I started praying to the God.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I ducked down as fast as I could."
entries.dialogueText: I ducked down as fast as I could.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I ducked down as fast as I could."
entries.dialogueText: I ducked down as fast as I could.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I closed my eyes."
entries.dialogueText: I closed my eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I started praying to God."
entries.dialogueText: I started praying to God.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Looking at the benches where the ne..."
entries.dialogueText: Looking at the benches where the new officers of the General Staff was sitting at, I saw Tarquin Soll.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From this distance it was hard to t..."
entries.dialogueText: From this distance it was hard to tell, but he tipped his hat off to me and I could swear that he was smiling.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Looking at the benches where the Ge..."
entries.dialogueText: Looking at the benches where the General Staff was sitting at, I saw Tarquin Soll sitting next to General Valken.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saluted the high ranking military..."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted the high ranking military staff and attaches from CSP. We shook hands before proceeding.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saluted the high ranking military..."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted the high ranking military staff and attaches from ATO. We shook hands before proceeding.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A brief gunfight ensued outside as..."
entries.dialogueText: A brief gunfight ensued outside as the police and soldiers rushed over to secure the vehicle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A brief gunfight ensued outside as..."
entries.dialogueText: A brief gunfight ensued outside as the police and soldiers rushed over to secure the vehicle. My head was spinning and my ears were still ringing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The car hit one of the soldiers. We..."
entries.dialogueText: The car hit one of the soldiers. We were about to crash into the truck in front of us.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I started praying to God."
entries.dialogueText: I started praying to God.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I closed my eyes."
entries.dialogueText: I closed my eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A brief gunfight ensued outside as..."
entries.dialogueText: A brief gunfight ensued outside as the police and soldiers rushed over to secure the vehicle. Iosef fired several more times towards the gunmen. My head was spinning and my ears were still ringing.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I held on as tight as I could."
entries.dialogueText: I held on as tight as I could.
entries.menuText: Hold on as tightly as you can.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I regained consciousness after the..."
entries.dialogueText: I regained consciousness after the crash. The muffled screams from the crowd combined with the car horn.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“He did nothing wrong.”"
entries.dialogueText: “He did nothing wrong.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“He served his country until the ve..."
entries.dialogueText: “He served his country until the very end.”
